name: Hakim
self_text: Coming from a nursing background, I have always appreciated the value of clear communication. These days, I spend my free time podcasting, which I find incredibly rewarding. I have turned to this activity right now as a way to focus on language practice. A typical session for me works best as a step-by-step walkthrough, as I get the most out of that format. I find that I do best with occasional short exchanges during our time together. I am happy to explain things to my partner, and I prefer meeting in person. Most weeks, I am available on Saturday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who has things explained by me, and you have to be okay with either complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges. It's a deal-breaker unless you are into a step-by-step walkthrough session. I'd strongly prefer that we overlap on in person, though it's not a requirement.
